title: Operations Overview – Live Atmospheric Engine
prompt:
Upgrade the Operations Overview screen into a fully functional, live-reactive weather atmospheric experience where EVERY SINGLE weather state is actively rendered and animated across a much wider and taller multi-layer canvas, not just Snow.

CRITICAL FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS TO IMPLEMENT IN THE SCREEN:
1. EXPANDED FULL-STAGE ATMOSPHERIC ENGINE:
   - Ensure the weather atmosphere layer is significantly wider and taller, spanning the full background behind the header and hero card (100% presence) and softly filtering behind the lower data cards (25-35% opacity with dark frosted glass cards `rgba(18,18,19,0.72)` and backdrop blur so all data remains crisp and readable).
   - Multi-layer depth:
     a) Background sky: responsive gradients, day/night ambient color, sun disc or moon glow, deep convective storm masses.
     b) Midground: dynamic atmospheric layers (rolling fog strata, heat shimmer waves, dense drifting clouds, cyclonic spiral bands, wind shear vectors).
     c) Foreground interactive particles: HTML5 Canvas or SVG dynamic particle simulation that renders distinctly for each scene:
        * SNOW: Multi-size drifting crystalline particles with gentle horizontal oscillation and wind drift.
        * RAIN: Slanted fast diagonal streaks (tilted ~15°), multi-depth opacities, subtle ripple rings on bottom surfaces.
        * HEAVY RAIN / CLOUDBURST: Intense dense rainfall streaks, lower atmospheric mist blur, rapid falling velocity.
        * THUNDERSTORM / LIGHTNING: Dark heavy convective clouds, heavy rain streaks, plus an actual periodic lightning flash trigger (illuminating an organic branching SVG lightning bolt at upper right accompanied by a brief ambient white flash fade every 4-7 seconds).
        * CLEAR / SUNNY: Large prominent soft sun orb at upper right with slowly rotating subtle geometric sun rays, warm sand/cream ambient sky, and delicate drifting sun motes.
        * CLOUDY: Multi-layered slow-drifting graphite/grey cloud banks with soft volumetric contours.
        * HEATWAVE: Radiant warm cream/sand sun glare, visible vertical rising heat-haze sine shimmer distortion, warm sand-to-copper horizon glow.
        * COLD WAVE / WINTER: Icy pale mist bands, creeping crystalline frost vignettes around viewport corners, subtle rising cold breath vapor (distinct from precipitation snow).
        * FOG / HAZE: Broad rolling horizontal fog strata thickening toward the bottom, delicate opacity gradients, muted synoptic visibility.
        * HIGH WIND: Fast horizontal wind streaks, airborne trajectory vectors, rapid cloud drift.
        * CYCLONE: Rotating spiral cloud arm vortex centered on Indian subcontinent coordinates with visible eye and driving concentric rain.
        * DUST STORM: Sweeping horizontal sand/grey particle squall, low atmospheric visibility.
        * NIGHT VARIANTS: Subtle lunar glow and restrained starry pinpoints for clear/cloudy/storm night states.

2. INTERACTIVE CONTROLS & SYNCHRONIZATION:
   - Expand the upper atmospheric bar with interactive chips for the complete 13-scene Sky strip (Auto, Clear, Cloudy, Rain, Cloudburst, Thunderstorm, Heatwave, Coldwave, Snow, Fog, Wind, Cyclone, Dust Storm) with an active pill indicator.
   - Sky mode switches smoothly via JavaScript into each scene immediately, changing the animated canvas/DOM layers, the hero temperature, condition title, humidity/rain stats, and the dynamic `--accent` token (e.g. Thunderstorm = #8B5CF6, Rain = #38BDF8, Clear = #FBBF24, Fog = #CBD5E1, Snow = #E0F2FE, Heat = #F59E0B, Strict Mono = #E9DFCB).
   - Include the "Now showing: [Condition] · [Lead] · [City]" caption with its glowing accent dot.
   - Lead-Time Scrubber (-48h to +240h, 6h increments) with Play/Pause button that smoothly steps through the forecast timeline and transitions the atmosphere.
   - Strict Monochrome toggle `[MONO]` that clamps all accents to warm sand `#E9DFCB`.
   - Intensity Slider (Low, Med, High) and Ambient toggle (ON/OFF).

3. PRESERVE 100% OF ALL OPERATIONAL DATA & METEOROLOGICAL MODULES:
   - New Delhi Safdarjung Observatory hero (34°C, Thunderstorm, 72% rain, 18 km/h wind, High · 91% Blend Confidence).
   - System Diagnostics (NCUM-G, NEPS-G, BharatFS, GraphCast, AIFS ECMWF, GenCast, GFS/NCEP).
   - Active Synoptic Regimes (Monsoon Trough, Cyclonic Circulation, Western Disturbance).
   - Synoptic Canvas (65°E–100°E, 5°N–40°N radar + AI contour overlay).
   - Priority Extreme Signals (+48h Arabian Sea Cyclone Track preservation at 72% AI probability).
   - Saved Telemetry Stations (Mumbai, Bengaluru, Shimla, Kochi) with direct tap-to-switch.
   - Lineage tooltip info (NCUM-G 21%, NEPS-G 18%, BharatFS 24%, GraphCast 17%, AIFS 20%).
   - Bottom Tab Navigation (Overview, Map, Blend AI, Extreme, More) and DPDP Act 2023 compliance notice.

Make the visual atmosphere undeniably wide, immersive, and fully working across all 12 weather states with smooth transitions!
